question: Which driver won the most recorded races? Give their first name, last name, nationality, and highest recorded driver-standings points total.
gold_sql: WITH wins AS (SELECT driverId, COUNT(*) AS win_count FROM results WHERE positionOrder = 1 GROUP BY driverId), winner AS (SELECT driverId FROM wins ORDER BY win_count DESC, driverId LIMIT 1) SELECT d.forename, d.surname, d.nationality, (SELECT MAX(s.points) FROM driverStandings AS s WHERE s.driverId = d.driverId) FROM winner AS w JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = w.driverId
